confidence_notes: Food prices are informed by Tromsø-specific cost-of-living data, while cocktail data is based on a small contributor sample. Wine is estimated slightly above local draft beer because a comparable restaurant-glass average is weak. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with substantial seasonal variation and was not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No substitute city used; local Tromsø price indexes inform food and drinks, with general Northern Norway tourism context for accommodation.
